title: Business valuation
learning_outcomes: Explain financial statements in the context of business valuation.
Compare and distinguish profit cash and value in the context of business valuation.
Apply valuation methods in the context of business valuation.
Evaluate and justify decisions about sensitivity in the context of business valuation.

lessons.title: Financial statements
lessons.outcome: Explain financial statements in the context of business valuation.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving financial statements; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to enterprise valuation memo.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain financial statements from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of financial statements; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Profit cash and value
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish profit cash and value in the context of business valuation.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving profit cash and value; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to enterprise valuation memo.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain profit cash and value from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of profit cash and value; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Valuation methods
lessons.outcome: Apply valuation methods in the context of business valuation.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving valuation methods; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to enterprise valuation memo.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain valuation methods from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of valuation methods; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Sensitivity
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about sensitivity in the context of business valuation.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving sensitivity; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to enterprise valuation memo.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain sensitivity from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of sensitivity; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of financial statements; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of profit cash and value; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of valuation methods; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of sensitivity; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.

safety.notes: Draft educational framework only. Use fictional cases; no personal diagnosis, prescription, hazardous practice, financial/legal instruction or unqualified certification. Obtain qualified/local review before publication.
